def bell_number(n):
    """Return the number of partitions of a set of n elements."""
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be non-negative")

    row = [1]
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        next_row = [row[-1]]
        for j in range(i):
            next_row.append(next_row[-1] + row[j])
        row = next_row

    return row[0]
